targets.description: Achieve carbon neutrality across the entire value chain by 2030, reducing related emissions by 75 percent compared with 2015.
targets.note: Report calls Apple 2030 a 'science-based commitment' (p.5) but does not state SBTi validation. Goals table shows 60% progress (p.5).

targets.description: Replenish all corporate freshwater withdrawals by 2030.

dataGaps.description: Upstream and downstream transport are reported together ('Product transportation (upstream and downstream) 2,370,000'), so categories 4 and 9 cannot be separated.
Waste is reported only by disposition route in pounds; whether hazardous waste overlaps the other routes is not stated, so no total is recorded.

comparabilityNotes: Apple splits Scope 3 into 'corporate' and 'product life cycle' blocks; the Scope 3 total here is their sum (derived).
Corporate carbon neutrality relies on retired carbon credits (pp.76-77); all figures here are gross emissions before credits.
